|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Probe Droid (V) (Virtual Set 4)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “Provides presence. Three times per turn, may deploy an Imperial to same site at - 1. While in battle, adds 1 to your total battle destiny for each Imperial here. When drawn for destiny, you may look at opponent's hand.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “''When drawn for destiny, you may peek at opponent’s hand.'' Provides presence. Thrice per turn, your Imperial may deploy -1 to same site. Your total battle destiny here is +1 for each Imperial here.” '''What changed:''' “Provides presence. Three times per turn, may deploy an Imperial to same site at - 1. While in battle, adds 1 to your total battle destiny for each Imperial here. When” → “''When”; “look” → “peek”; “opponent's hand.” → “opponent’s hand.'' Provides presence. Thrice per turn, your Imperial may deploy -1 to same site. Your total battle destiny here is +1 for each Imperial here.”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153629/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards4.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 4, slip 43. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Probe Droid]].
